scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical for every stated field; finite-field code tests a finite sample and does not constitute an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-one coefficients on two-dimensional prime-field linear supports; not arbitrary supports or complex weights.
Odd characteristic and extension degree at least three; full unnormalized quadratic Fourier measurements.
The Gaussian modulus formula and symmetric-matrix rank counts are classical ingredients; residual risk of an unindexed exact-spectrum equivalent.
title: Exact parabolic Fourier spectra of two-dimensional additive planes
